name: photo-select-grid
title: Photo select grid
description: Choose many photos from a library of hundreds: click or Space to toggle, Shift for a range, Ctrl A for all, with a live count and an optional limit.
docs: Pass photos ({ id, src, alt }) and the chosen ids as selected with onSelectedChange (or defaultSelected). Each photo is a checkbox named by its alt, with a circle that fills with a check. Click toggles; Shift-click chooses everything between the last photo you clicked and this one; Space toggles; Shift with an arrow key or Space extends a range (moving back takes the extra photos out); Control or Cmd with A chooses all; Escape clears. The grid is one tab stop and the arrow keys move like a grid. The status line ("3 selected") is a polite live region. maxSelect limits the choice: at the limit the others dim, the status line says "6 of 6 selected, limit reached" and a note under the grid says what to do. With onOpen, selecting starts with the first chosen photo: until then a plain click opens the photo and only the circle chooses it. Hundreds of photos are fine: tiles are memoised and pictures load lazily. Below 28rem of room the toolbar is two rows: the choice, the count and Clear, then your actions. columns, ratio, actions, labels, locale.
